about_short_description.short_description: Fello is a savings and investment platform that helps to save, invest and earn higher returns than a traditional savings account.

product.name: Fello Dedicated Advisor
product.description: A year-long personal financial advisory service providing tailored financial planning, execution support, and ongoing accountability.

product.name: In-House Investment Opportunities
product.description: Curated investment options designed by Fello’s financial experts, offering a range of risk profiles and growth potentials.

product.name: Personalized Insurance Advisory
product.description: Professional insurance recommendations tailored to individual financial situations and lifestyle needs.

product.name: Tax Planning and Filing Support
product.description: Assistance with tax-saving strategies, income tax return filing, and compliance managed by certified financial professionals.

product.name: Financial Education and Resources
product.description: Educational content and guidance on personal finance topics such as credit scores, loans, and investment basics.

product.name: Fello Partner Program
product.description: A referral and commission program for financial advisors and wealth managers to promote Fello’s investment products.
